title: Newly Established Ferry Company Equity Stake For Sale in North Lombok Regency
tagline: Fast ferry operator in the busiest passenger ferry route in the world (Bali-Gili). The business started operations in March this year. - Foreign-invested company (PMA), operates in the tourism-related maritime transport and travel agency sectors. - The company has been operational for approximately six months, generating monthly sales of around USD 300,000. - Its fleet consists of two fast boats, each with a capacity of 120 passengers. - The revenue model is based on the sale of fast boat tickets and tour packages connecting Bali and the Gili Islands. Booked 100% throughout the beginning of operations. - Very high operational margin as fuel costs 50% of revenue and employee costs are only USD 20 thousand per month. - The company carries no external debt or loans and employs a staff of around 20 people. Only a staff of 20 people is required right now to operate 2 boats.
